summary: CR-106 (UrbanPiper / Swiggy / Zomato Aggregator Module) QA validation. Code-level review of all 5 new files and 6 modified files: PASS. Frontend compiles with 0 new errors (only pre-existing react-hooks warnings). Live E2E on preprod.mygenie.online (restaurant 478): login OK, dashboard boot fetch OK, 4 aggregator orders loaded, socket subscribed to aggregator_order_478, aggregator Ready button renders correctly for status=1 orders, POS Bill/Cancel/Serve buttons correctly hidden for aggregator orders. AggregatorOrderPopOut, AggregatorRejectModal, AggregatorDispatchModal could NOT be exercised in-browser because no aggregator orders currently exist in f_order_status=0/7 (popup trigger) or f_order_status=2 (dispatch trigger). ONE CRITICAL DESIGN GAP found: TableCard.jsx (used for Delivery-channel aggregator cards) does NOT render the S/Z source badge — only OrderCard has renderLogo(); aggregator orders render as TableCard so the mockup-required orange 'S' / red 'Z' circle badge is missing from every aggregator card in the dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: S/Z source badge NOT rendered for aggregator orders. TableCard has no equivalent to OrderCard's renderLogo() (OrderCard.jsx:353-371). Aggregator orders in Delivery column render via TableCard (data-testid='table-card-delivery-*'), and their header only shows a bike icon + 'Del/DEL' text + amount — no orange S / red Z circle. Users cannot distinguish Swiggy from Zomato at a glance. Verified live: cards table-card-delivery-892353, 40474-40477 all have zero single-letter S/Z badges in DOM. Mockup section 3 requires the S/Z badge in card header.

issues: Header text is 'Reject Order' — mockup calls for 'Reject Aggregator Order'.
Confirm button label is 'Reject Order' — mockup calls for 'Confirm Reject'.
Confirm button label is 'Dispatch' — mockup calls for 'Confirm Dispatch'.

action_items: HIGH: Add S/Z source badge rendering to TableCard.jsx header (mirror OrderCard.jsx:353-371 renderLogo). Aggregator orders currently render through TableCard and have zero source-badge on live dashboard.
LOW: Align modal titles/labels with mockup — 'Reject Aggregator Order' / 'Confirm Reject' / 'Confirm Dispatch'.

INFO: To fully exercise AggregatorOrderPopOut/Reject/Dispatch modals in QA, seed test aggregator orders in f_order_status=0 or 7 (popup) and =2 (dispatch) — none exist on preprod restaurant 478 right now.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is >2000 lines — refactor CR-106 handlers (handleAggregatorAccept/Reject/Ready/Dispatch) into a custom hook (e.g. useAggregatorLifecycle).
aggregatorTransform.js: line 29 hard-codes 'plateform' misspelling — good comment call-out; consider extracting a normalizer wrapper for defense against backend spelling fixes.

aggregatorService.js: no explicit error handling — errors bubble to caller (OK because handlers in DashboardPage wrap in try/catch), but a 401/network fault will surface as toast-less failure. Consider central axios interceptor coverage confirmation.
AggregatorDispatchModal: rider phone validation is >=10 chars only — no numeric-only / country-code check. Acceptable for MVP.
AggregatorOrderPopOut: safety reset for isAccepting is a 8s timer — if socket update lands earlier, timer still fires; harmless but noisy.

success_rate.backend: N/A (external Laravel backend not in scope)
success_rate.frontend: code 100% / live E2E 85% (popup+modals not exercisable without seed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-106 wiring end-to-end confirmed live: boot fetch (4 orders), socket subscription (aggregator_order_478), Ready button (ready-btn-delivery-*), read-only aggregator cards. Remaining unverified paths: (1) AggregatorOrderPopOut rendering + Accept flow — needs an order in f_order_status=0/7. (2) AggregatorRejectModal — same. (3) AggregatorDispatchModal — needs an order in f_order_status=2. Any of these can be tested by seeding via urbanpiper webhook or by finding a restaurant with live traffic. Also: TableCard S/Z badge gap — fix and re-verify by checking any [data-testid^='table-card-delivery-*'] has a single-letter S/Z child with orange/red background.
